witness.source:
use chelis_checker_core::errors::ErrorWitness;
pub fn forge() -> ErrorWitness { ErrorWitness(()) }

witness-vector.source: pub fn forge(errors: &mut Vec<chelis_checker_core::CheckError>, error: chelis_checker_core::CheckError) { chelis_checker_core::errors::report(errors, error); }

checkpoint.source:
use chelis_checker_core::DiagnosticCheckpoint;
pub fn forge() { let _ = DiagnosticCheckpoint(0usize); }

completion-fields.source: pub fn forge(facts: chelis_checker_core::CheckFacts) -> chelis_checker_core::CompletedCheck { chelis_checker_core::CompletedCheck { facts } }

checked-fields.source: pub fn forge(facts: chelis_checker_core::CheckFacts) -> chelis_types::CheckedProgram { chelis_types::CheckedProgram { facts, library_proof_id: None, context_library_proof_id: None } }

facts-adoption.source: pub fn forge(facts: chelis_checker_core::CheckFacts) -> chelis_types::CheckedProgram { facts.into() }

completion-adoption.source: pub fn forge(completion: chelis_checker_core::CompletedCheck) -> chelis_types::CheckedProgram { completion.into() }

facts-completion.source: pub fn forge(facts: chelis_checker_core::CheckFacts) -> chelis_checker_core::CompletedCheck { facts.into() }

context-admission.source: pub fn forge(snapshot: chelis_checker_core::ContextSnapshot) -> chelis_types::TypeEnv { snapshot.into() }
